messages:
maria: Quick design check — the 'Latency over time' chart in Console feels noisy. Two specific things: legend gets crowded when customers select many models, and the Y axis units flip between ms and s which confuses PMs. Screenshot posted in thread.

ashok: Agree. Legend should collapse into a compact list + a 'show all' dropdown. Hover to highlight series. :point_up: Also propose truncating labels to 20 chars and showing full name on hover.

jamie: For units: default to ms for <= 1000ms, otherwise s. But we should surface a unit toggle in the legend header so users can pick. Small copy: 'Units: ms | s'.

olivia: On smoothing — some customers want raw spikes for debugging. Suggest a smoothing toggle (off / light / heavy) and a little info tooltip: 'Smoothing hides transient spikes; use raw for debugging'. Keep smoothing as a client-side transform not server-side.

maria: Good call. UX question: should smoothing be global per dashboard or per-chart? I lean per-chart so you can compare raw vs smoothed across panels.

ashok: Per-chart is better. Implementation note: we can expose a param in our chart config, e.g.: 
```json
{
  "legend": { "position": "right", "collapsible": true },
  "yAxis": {
    "unit": "auto", // ms | s | auto
    "tickCallback": "formatLatency",
    "clampOutliers": false
  },
  "smoothing": { "mode": "ema", "window": 5 }
}
```

jamie: Also want 50th and 95th lines by default (light dashed for p95). Label those in legend as 'p50' and 'p95'.

olivia: For outliers: add a small CTA 'Show outliers' that overlays raw points above the chart. Otherwise huge spikes compress the whole view.

maria: Accessibility: a11y-bot had some notes, right?

a11y-bot: Quick suggestions: 1) Use our colorblind-safe palette for stroke colors (avoid red/green pairs). 2) Add high-contrast mode toggle for charts. 3) Legend items must be keyboard-focusable and togglable via Enter/Space. 4) Add ARIA labels describing data series counts.

ashok: Re: colors — we can add pattern/fill for lines when users enable high-contrast. Also add distinct markers for p50/p95 so color alone isn't the only distinguisher.

jamie: Copy tweak: change 'Hide series' to 'Toggle series' in the legend menu — less negative.

maria: I'll make a quick Figma mock with: collapsed legend, per-chart smoothing toggle (off/light/heavy), unit toggle, 'Show outliers' CTA, p50/p95 defaults, and accessibility notes. Will post link when ready. :sparkles:

olivia: Awesome — can you include a compact mobile layout? On small screens the legend should become a pager below the chart.

maria: Yep, will include mobile pager and the keyboard focus state. Will ping product and eng once mock is up. :thumbsup:
